description: Exact English generation sessions used in the published article and reused as the fixed baseline for the Yoruba-first module.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet.substitution_reason: Anthropic direct and OpenRouter no longer expose any Claude 3.5 Sonnet variant on this account; only Claude Sonnet 4 and later are available. Anthropic direct probe (GET /v1/models) returned no claude-3-5-* IDs, and OpenRouter exposes only claude-3.5-haiku from the 3.5 family.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet.substitution_note: Yoruba Claude runs use Claude Sonnet 4 (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) as the closest available Sonnet-tier substitute. Cross-language comparison against the published English Claude 3.5 Sonnet baseline must therefore be treated as cross-generation Sonnet rather than same-model replication, and this gap must be reported in the methods section.
